title: Construction and characterization of a temperature-sensitive pRC4 replicon for Rhodococcus and Gordonia.
authors: Deedwania, Agrima; Karmakar, Shreyoshi; Kumar, Vipul; Shefrin, Seyad; Sundar, Durai; Srivastava, Preeti
one_liner_zh: 该文构建温度敏感型质粒复制子，虽涉及DNA结合复制蛋白的分子模拟，但核心是质粒复制工程而非TF-DNA转录结合互作，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Temperature-sensitive plasmids are useful for genome engineering and several synthetic biology applications. There are only limited reports on temperature-sensitive plasmids for Rhodococcus and none for Gordonia. Here, we report the construction of a temperature-sensitive pRC4 replicon that is functional in Rhodococcus and Gordonia. The amino acid residues were predicted for the temperature-sensitive phenotype in the pRC4 replicon using in silico methods and molecular simulation of the DNA-binding replication protein with the origin of replication. The amino acid residues were mutated, and the temperature-sensitive phenotype was validated in Gordonia sp. IITR100. Similar results were also observed in Rhodococcus erythropolis, suggesting that the temperature-sensitive phenotype was exhibited across genera.
abstract_zh: 温度敏感型质粒在基因组工程及多种合成生物学应用中具有重要价值。目前，关于红球菌属的温度敏感型质粒报道有限，而戈登氏菌属则尚无相关报道。在此，我们报告了一种在红球菌属和戈登氏菌属中均有功能的温度敏感型pRC4复制子的构建。通过计算机模拟方法及DNA结合复制蛋白与复制起点的分子模拟，预测了pRC4复制子中与温度敏感表型相关的氨基酸残基。对这些氨基酸残基进行了突变，并在戈登氏菌属IITR100菌株中验证了温度敏感表型。在红平红球菌中也观察到了类似结果，表明该温度敏感表型具有跨属表现。
